Dow Jones Adds Alphabet, Wall Street Sees Tech Rebound

The Dow Jones Industrial Average has added Alphabet to its index, signaling a tilt towards technology stocks. Wall Street experienced a surge, with the Dow jumping 300 points and the Nasdaq up 0.7%. This rebound was driven by significant semiconductor investment announcements and strong performance in tech stocks, particularly those related to artificial intelligence. SpaceX also saw positive movement, with expectations of joining the Nasdaq 100.
